our method is a practical and simple method of defining and verifying abstract models of systems.

our method is a general framework for defining quotient abstractions, and we show how to use it in the context of Maude to define quotient abstractions for a wide range of systems, including Petri nets, process algebras, and timed automata.

quotient abstractions can be defined by equations, and that this approach is simpler and more flexible than the usual quotient construction.
